messages:
Olivia Chen: Hi all  I'm Olivia, joined AE team today. Two quick items: CRM seat (Salesforce) and call tooling (Gong/Aircall). Also looking for the "one-pager" on enterprise pricing. Who's the contact for each? :wave:
Ravi Desai: welcome Olivia!! :tada: Sales Ops handles SF + Aircall. I'll kick off provisioning. Gong invites come from Revenue Ops (they own recordings/compliance).
Olivia Chen: thanks Ravi. My work email is olivia.chen@redwood.ai and I'm on EST.
Ravi Desai: added ticket SOPS-7729 for Salesforce + Aircall. ETA: same business day for Aircall, SF provisioning takes 4 business hours once approved. Do you need mobile SSO?
Olivia Chen: yes please, iPhone 13 on iOS 16.
Maya Lin: hey @Olivia  I'm your CS partner. For handoffs we use the Gainsight/Notion combo. Make sure you complete the "Deal Handoff" form before close. Link: https://redwood-internal/notion/cs-handoff
Olivia Chen: copied. Is there a template for the playbook or scripts I should start with?
Theo Martin: put you in the AE playbook channel — AE_playbooks. Theo Martin: There's a short "first 30 days" checklist and cold-call scripts. I'll DM the script pack and a quick roleplay schedule.
CS Handovers Bot: SYSTEM: New handoff template assigned to olivia.chen@redwood.ai. Deadline for initial completion: 7 days. Ticket: CS-4112.
Ravi Desai: FYI pricing one-pager is in Notion: https://redwood-internal/notion/sales-collateral/pricebook_quick_ref. Filename: Pricebook_quick_ref_v3.pdf
Olivia Chen: I can't access the pricebook (403).
Ravi Desai: permission issue. Fixed now, should be able to view/download.
Olivia Chen: works! Any quick notes on when to escalate to CS vs handle internally?
Maya Lin: short rule: >$5k ARR or custom integration requests -> loop CS. Also any active compliance questions (SOC2/enterprise data locality) -> CS + Security.
Olivia Chen: good to know. For Gong legal consent: do we need customer permission to record demos?
Theo Martin: standard: include recording notice in invite/first slide. Legal already approved the generic consent language in the TOFU deck.
Olivia Chen: thanks 44D . One last thing: who owns the outbound sequences template for Outreach? I want to reuse a proven sequence.
Ravi Desai: Outreach sequences are in the shared folder: Outreach/Sequences/AE_Default. I'll add you. Also sample CSV headers for imports: ```
email,first_name,last_name,company,job_title,lead_source,owner
```
Olivia Chen: perfect. Appreciate everyone's help. I'll wait for the SF invite and then jump into mock calls.
Maya Lin: added you to the mock call rota for Thursday 11am ET. Invite incoming.
CS Handovers Bot: SYSTEM: Salesforce seat provisioned (ticket SOPS-7729). Status: complete.
Olivia Chen: saw the SF invite and completed 2FA setup. All good on my end. Thanks team! :sparkles:
